props.gloss_en: the mishnah: one who blessed over the wine before the meal has exempted the wine after the meal
the mishnah: wine came to them during the meal -- each one blesses for himself; after the meal -- one blesses for all
R' Yochanan: [the mishnah's rule] was taught only of Shabbatot and festivals
since [on those occasions] a man fixes his meal on the wine
but on the rest of the days of the year one blesses over each and every cup
RYBL: [the mishnah's rule] was taught only of Shabbatot and festivals, when a man comes out of the bathhouse, and at bloodletting
on a weekday Rava blessed [over wine] before the meal and blessed again after the meal
on a festival Abaye blessed over each and every cup
wine that came during the meal: its blessing exempts the wine after the meal
Rav Nachman: this is what the mishnah says -- if wine came to them not during the meal but only after it, one blesses for all

supports.gloss_en: אמר ליה: יישר, וכן אמר רבי יהושע בן לוי -- well done; RYBL said so too (on the rest of the year one blesses over each cup)

objections.gloss_en: לא סבר לה מר להא דרבי יהושע בן לוי?! -- on a festival, by RYBL, the first blessing suffices; why does the master bless over each cup?

איתיביה רבא לרב נחמן: wine during the meal -- each blesses for himself; after the meal -- one blesses for all: the after-meal wine gets a blessing although wine came during the meal, so the during-meal wine did not exempt it
